Reference / testing/double

testing/double#

Test doubles: record the calls a fake receives, and stub answers.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let calls is RecordedCalls<string> = RecordedCalls();
calls.record("sent " + to);
test.is(calls.size(), 1);

let answers = Stub(["first", "second"]);
answers.next();                        // "first"; StubExhausted after the last

Description#

Test doubles: record the calls a fake receives, and stub answers.

They work only inside a test.
